text:
elaine: Quick sync — partner 'Atlas' asked for a pilot pricing layout. Need a concrete proposal (tiers, add-ons, SLA shape, and pilot concessions) by EOD so I can hand to sales.
sam: They flagged predictable spend as the top ask. Prefer commit + soft burst; legal asked for 99.9% SLO language + service credits in contract.
anya: From finance POV we can do a 6-week pilot with an account credit, but need floor commitments if we enable burst. Need concrete numbers.
mike: On infra — perf targets matter. For the Performance tier we should aim for ~150ms p95 for short requests. Burst requires reserved capacity or risk noisy neighbor impact.
elaine: Draft tiers idea — throwing this up for quick reactions:
```
Starter:
  - commit: $3k/mo (pilot floor)
  - qps: 5 sustained
  - token cap: 1M/mo
  - burst add-on: purchasable credits (up to 200% for short bursts)

Performance:
  - commit: $25k/mo
  - qps: 50 sustained
  - token cap: 20M/mo
  - SLA: 99.9% uptime, credits for outages

Pilot concessions:
  - 6-week pilot
  - 100k free tokens + $2k usage credit
  - No formal SLA during pilot (we can mention expected SLO)
```
sam: Clean and concise. Partner will push for lower starter floor or per-seat alternative — they have a 40-person machine learning org.
anya: If they want per-seat we can offer an add-on: $20/seat/mo for admin seats (limits apply). Otherwise finance needs the $3k floor on starter or we take too much risk.
pricing-bot: cost-estimate: Starter unit margin ~28% at $3k floor, Performance margin ~42% at $25k commit. Burst enabled increases infra exposure ~+12% cost unless throttled.
mike: Implementation notes: burst credits require a token bucket and short reservation window. If we reserve capacity for burst, estimate +2 GPUs for worst-case pilot concurrency (can optimize with adaptive routing).
elaine: Proposal for the doc to send partner tomorrow: two-tier pilot + optional per-seat add-on + explicit burst credits (metered) + pilot credits. Ask: @anya confirm floors, @mike confirm infra delta and rollback plan, @sam prep customer-facing language.
anya: Confirmed on floors. I can sign off on the $3k starter and $25k performance for pilot terms. Per-seat add-on at $20/seat OK but needs a usage cap clause.
mike: I'll provide a short runbook for capacity and a fallback to degraded routing (lower qps) if burst overwhelms pool. ETA for notes: 24h.
sam: I'll present this to Atlas tomorrow and push hard for Performance commit. Will surface any counteroffers asap. :thumbsup:
elaine: Great — I'll put this in a one-pager and DM legal for the SLO wording. Thanks team.
